concept: S3 Lifecycle: cascading storage classes to match access patterns
tests: Picking a chain of transitions for declining access frequency, retention period, and acceptable retrieval time.
expected: Standard for 30 days → Standard-IA on day 30 → Glacier Deep Archive on day 90. Triggers: "retain for 7 years", "retrieval within 12 hours" ⇒ Deep Archive (Standard retrieval up to 12 h); "occasionally" ⇒ Standard-IA.
why_not: Everything in Standard overpays for cold data; One Zone-IA risks loss on AZ failure and costs more than Deep Archive; Intelligent-Tiering with its monitoring fee costs more than explicit transitions when the pattern is known.
